251: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, empty of the Name, the whole world passes its life to no purpose. ॥1॥
O God, the dust of Your servants' feet makes one pure.
ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ; ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
Fortunate are those whose minds long for this dust.
ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ; ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
They do not ask for wealth and have no wish for heaven;
ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
they stay absorbed in love of their dearly loved God and in the dust of the feet of the holy.
No entanglement of Maya can press upon those
ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ; ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
who do not leave the One and go off anywhere else.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ; ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
Those in whose hearts God has set His Name,
O Nanak, are perfect saints, the form of God. ॥4॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਮਨਹਠਿ. ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
By many religious garbs, by learned talk, by meditation forced through stubbornness of mind, no one meets God.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Says Nanak: only the one on whom God's mercy falls becomes a devotee and comes to know Him closely. ॥1॥
Knowing God does not come from mere talk of the mouth,
nor from using the many kinds of method in the Shastras.
ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
He alone knows God in whose heart God is firmly settled.
ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ; ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
Just speaking and hearing about union does not bring union with God.
ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ; ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
The real knower is the one in whose heart God's will stays firmly fixed;
ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
to him all pain and pleasure seem alike.
The one who through the Guru reflects on the qualities of God, the source of the world,
O Nanak, the one on whom God shows mercy, comes to know Him. ॥5॥
ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
They came into the world as humans in name only; without understanding the right way of life they stayed beasts and cattle.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, that person understands it through the Guru on whose forehead good fortune awakens. ॥1॥
ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
A person is born into this life only to remember the One,
but from the moment of birth the deceiver Maya cheats him.
ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
In the mother's womb, hanging upside down, beings worship God,
and there they keep remembering Him with every breath.
Yet they stay tangled all their lives in the Maya that must be left behind,
and put the Giver of everything out of their minds.
O Master, the person on whom You show Your mercy,
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, never loses You from his mind, in this world or the next. ॥6॥
ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ; ਆਗਿਆ. ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
By God's command a being is born and by His command it dies; no one can stand outside that command.
ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the coming and going ends only for the one in whose mind He lives. ॥1॥
These beings come to live in a great many births;
drunk on sweet attachment, they are caught in the round of births.
ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
This Maya has brought them under the power of her three qualities,
and she has planted attachment to herself in every heart.
O friend, tell me of some remedy
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ; ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
by which I may cross over this hard Maya.
The one whom God in His mercy joins to the company of the holy,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, Maya cannot come near. ॥7॥
ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ; ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
All deeds done, good and bad, that God Himself is doing.
ਪਸੁ. ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Yet the fool boasts "I do it"; O Nanak, without the Lord's prompting what can anyone do? ॥1॥
The One who causes beings to act is God alone;
He Himself has spread out the whole range of bad deeds and good.
ਇਆ ਜੁਗ; ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
In this human birth, whichever way He Himself sets them, that way beings go;
ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ; ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
they take up only the understanding that He Himself gives.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
No one can know the limit of His qualities;
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
only what He Himself does comes to pass.
This whole spread of the world has spread out from the One;
O Nanak, He Himself sets beings on the straight path. ॥8॥
ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ. ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ; ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
We stay absorbed in the pleasures of women and the like, but this show of Maya is as brief as the colour of safflower.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, I take refuge in that God by whose grace "I" and "mine" pass away. ॥1॥
252: ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
O my mind, wherever you give your love other than to God, there the bonds of Maya fall on you.
ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ. ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Those cut off from God do just those things by which there is never any release from these bonds.
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ. ਕਰਮ ਰਤ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
Those devoted to ritual deeds go about proud of having done them, and the weight of that pride is unbearable.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
If no love for God's Name has grown, these deeds themselves turn into vice.
ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
Caught in the shows of sweet Maya, beings are bound in death's noose.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ. ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Lost in wandering, they do not grasp that God is always with us.
ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ. ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
If our account is reckoned we cannot be acquitted; a wall of mud is never washed clean.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
O Nanak, the one to whom God Himself gives understanding comes to the Guru, and his mind becomes pure. ॥9॥
ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ; ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
The one whose bonds of Maya are about to break gains the company of the Guru.
ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those dyed in the love of the One take a colour so deep that it never fades. ॥1॥
Dye this mind of yours in the colour of God's Name;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
with your tongue keep repeating the Lord's Name.
ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ; ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Then in God's presence no one speaks a rude word to you;
you are received with honour: "Come, sit down."
You find a place to stay in God's presence,
and there is no more round of birth and death, and no death of the spirit.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ; ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
But the one on whose forehead God's mercy has been written from the very first,
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
O Nanak, in the home of his heart alone this wealth of the Name is gathered. ॥10॥
ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
Greed, falsehood, vice and attachment overpower the blind fools;
ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ. ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, caught in the bonds of Maya, they stay busy with foul deeds. ॥1॥
Those who cling to the tastes of the senses and stay soaked in them,
whose understanding is veiled by pride, drunk with the wine of Maya,
are trapped in this Maya and fall into the round of birth and death.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Beings act only as God's will has them act.
By his own cleverness no one is made complete and no one is left wanting;
by his own strength no one has become wise and no one has stayed a fool.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
O God, whichever way You direct beings, that is the way they take.
O Nanak, the Master Himself is always beyond the reach of Maya. ॥11॥
ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
God is loved by all, the keeper of creation, the knower of all, great of heart, a sea too deep to be sounded.
ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
No worry comes near Him; O Nanak, there is no second like Him. ॥1॥
ਲਲਾ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
There is no one who is the equal of that God.
He alone is like Himself; there is no other.
He has been in being from all time,
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
and no one has found the far limit of His being.
From the ant to the elephant He fills all, completely.
That all-pervading Being is plain to see in every place.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
The one to whom God has given the taste of His own Name,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, comes to the Guru and always repeats it. ॥12॥
ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Those who have come to know this joy of the spirit, and who in a steady state enjoy the taste of remembering God,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ; ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, they are the fortunate ones; their birth into the world has borne fruit. ॥1॥
Count as fruitful the coming into the world of that person alone
ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
whose tongue is always speaking God's praise.
Those who come and stay in the presence of the Guru
remember God's Name with love at every hour.
That person stays steeped in the Name
on whom the Creator's mercy and kindness have fallen.
ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Such a person is born once only and does not come into births again and again,
O Nanak, the one who stays absorbed in the sight of God. ॥13॥
ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
By repeating whose Name joy rises in the mind and love of anything other than God goes,
ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
and the craving for Maya with its pain and distress is put out: O Nanak, stay settled in His Name. ॥1॥
253: Burn away bad thinking and the love of Maya;
only by giving these up do you rest in peace and steadiness.
Go and take the refuge of the saints,
for with that support this ocean of the world is crossed.
That one does not come into birth again and again
who takes the Name of the One and threads it into his mind.
ਯਯਾ. ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
With the support of the perfect Guru, the human birth is not wasted.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, the one in whose heart the One has come to live has gained joy of the spirit. ॥14॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ; ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
The friend of this world and the next comes to live within that person's mind and body at all times.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
The God whom the perfect Guru shows to be near, O Nanak, should be remembered always. ॥1॥
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Keep in mind at every hour the One who helps at the last moment.
ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ; ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
This Maya is a companion for ten days only; everyone leaves it here and goes.
ਕਾ ਕੋ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
Mother, father, son, daughter: none is anyone's companion for ever.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ; ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
House, wife, nothing at all can be taken along from here.
Gather a capital that never perishes,
so that you may go with honour to your own home.
Those who, born as humans, sang God's praise in the company of the holy,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਤੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, did not come again into the round of birth and death. ॥15॥
ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ. ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ; ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ, ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
People may be very handsome, of good family, clever, learned and rich,
ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
but O Nanak, those who have no love for God within are called dead. ॥1॥
Someone may know the six Shastras,
may practise drawing the breath up, holding it and letting it down,
may discuss religion, sit in meditation, bathe at places of pilgrimage,
may cook his food with his own hands for purity's sake and live in the forests,
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
but if there is no love in his mind for God's Name,
then whatever he has done, he has done for nothing.
Better than him I count a man of the lowest caste,
O Nanak, in whose mind God lives. ॥16॥
ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ; ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
Beings wander to the four quarters and the ten directions, driven by the imprint of the deeds they have done.
ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, joy and sorrow, release or the round of births, all come according to the writ that is written. ॥1॥
The Creator Himself makes the causes of all that happens.
No one can rub out the writ He has written.
He never has to do anything a second time;
the Maker does not make mistakes.
To one He Himself shows the right path;
another He Himself leaves to wander in the wilderness and to regret.
This whole play of the world He has made Himself.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, whatever He gives to beings, that is what they get. ॥17॥
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ; ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ. ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
They eat, spend and enjoy, yet their stores never run out;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, so many people repeat God's Name that they cannot be numbered. ॥1॥
ਖਖਾ. ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
God holds all power, and nothing is lacking with Him.
ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ; ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
He gives everything there is to give to His devotees, who walk wherever He wills.
ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ; ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
The wealth of the Name is the devotees' capital, the treasure they always spend from.
ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ; ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
They keep remembering God, the treasury of virtues, and forgiveness, humility, joy and steadiness grow in them.
ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ. ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Those to whom He is kind play the game of life with joy and are always in bloom.
ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
They are always rich and their faces shine, for the wealth of the Name is in the home of their hearts.
ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ, ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Those on whom God looks with favour know no distress, no pain, and feel no duty as a penalty.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ; ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, those who please God come through with success. ॥18॥
254: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ. ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ; ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
Think it through carefully in your mind and see: the whole world must certainly depart.
ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, by coming to the Guru the hope set on passing things is wiped out; the Name keeps the mind free of that disease. ॥1॥
ਗਗਾ. ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Keep the qualities of God in mind; with every breath, always, repeat His Name.
ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ; ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
What trust can be put in this body? Do not delay, friend.
ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ; ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Childhood, youth, old age: none of them is any bar to death.
ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ. ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
The hour cannot be known when death's rope falls round the neck.
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ; ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ. ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
See: the learned, the meditators, the clever, none of them stays in this place for ever.
ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ; ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
Only fools cling to the things that all the world has left behind and gone.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
The one on whose forehead good fortune is written keeps remembering God by the Guru's grace.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, blessed is the coming into the world of those who have the beloved God as their husband. ॥19॥
ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਬੇਦ ਸਭ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
I have studied all the Shastras and Vedas; none of them says that anyone other than God is everlasting.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He alone is, from the beginning, from the start of the ages, now, and hereafter. ॥1॥
ਘਘਾ. ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Fix this firmly in your mind: apart from God no other is everlasting.
ਨਹ ਹੋਆ. ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
There has been none and there will be none; in every place it is He who is present.
ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ; ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
O mind, only if you come to His refuge do you taste the joy.
In this human birth the Name alone can wipe out the effect of sins done.
Many toil and toil at other labours and in the end only regret it.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Without devotion to God the mind finds rest nowhere.
ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
He has stirred and drunk the nectar of the Name, the sweetest of tastes,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
O Nanak, the one to whom the Guru has given the gift of God's Name. ॥20॥
ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ. ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ; ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ. ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
God sends a being into the world with all its days and breaths counted, and they do not grow or shrink by so much as a sesame seed.
ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, they are fools who, lost in attachment, want to live longer than that. ॥1॥
ਙੰਙਾ. ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
The fear of death seizes those whom God has cut off from Himself.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
They have not recognised the all-pervading God, and they go on being born and dying in countless births.
Knowledge of God and attention fixed on Him have come only to those
to whom He Himself, in His mercy, has given this gift.
No one escapes by reckoning and calculating;
the unbaked pot is certain to break.
Count as living only the one who, while alive, has remembered God.
O Nanak, such a person does not stay hidden; he becomes known in the world. ॥21॥
ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ. ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਊਧ ਕਵਲ. ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
I hold God's lovely feet in my heart, and the mind that had turned away opens like a lotus.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching God Himself comes to show Himself there. ॥1॥
When a person's forehead touches the Guru's lovely feet,
ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ; ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
count that day blessed and that moment fortunate.
ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
A being may wander through the four quarters and the ten directions;
the sight of God comes only when His mercy falls.
His thoughts become clean, and all love of Maya comes to an end;
in the Guru's company his mind becomes pure.
He drops every other thought and sees the One alone,
O Nanak, the one whose eyes are touched with the salve of understanding. ॥22॥
ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ. ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ; ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
May my heart be cooled and my mind be at ease by singing the verses of Your praise:
ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
O God, show me such mercy. Says Nanak: I am the slave of Your slaves. ॥1॥
I am Your servant, Your child;
let me be the water-carrier for the servants of Your servants.
Let me become the dust of the feet of Your saints,
255: O God, show this mercy of Yours.
O mind, give up all your cleverness and shrewdness
and take hold of the support of the saints.
ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Though his body is only a puppet of dust, he reaches the highest spiritual state in it,
O Nanak, the person whom the saints help. ॥23॥
ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ; ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Those who swell with pride in their force and tyranny over others waste their perishable bodies.
ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
They are tied in the bonds of the "I am great" way of thinking; O Nanak, only the Name can free them. ॥1॥
One who begins to think, "I have become someone great,"
is trapped in that pride as a parrot, fooled by the bait, is caught on the snare.
When a person thinks, "I have become a devotee, I have become wise,"
the Lord hereafter sets not the slightest value on that pride.
When a person thinks, "I give fine religious discourses,"
he only roams the earth like a pedlar, selling to others and gaining nothing himself.
The person who has destroyed his pride in the company of the holy,
O Nanak, he it is who meets God. ॥24॥
ਝਾਲਾਘੇ. ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Rise in the hours before dawn and repeat the Name; remember Him day and night.
ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
No worry will weigh on you; O Nanak, the quarrelsome nature of enmity will go from within you. ॥1॥
Your worry will be wiped away
if you trade in God's Name.
One cut off from God stays spiritually dead in worry and regret,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
because love of Maya has taken hold in his heart.
All sins and vices will drop away from your mind
if you go to the company of the holy and hear the life-giving praise of God.
Lust, anger and all such enemies are destroyed
O Nanak, in the person on whom the Master of creation shows mercy. ॥25॥
ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ; ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
Try as many ways as you like, my friend, you cannot stay here for ever.
ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, if you love the Name and always remember God, you will have spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ; ਬਿਨਸਿ; ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
Know this for certain: these worldly attachments will perish.
ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ. ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ; ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
How many have gone from here I do not count, nor can I count.
ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ; ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Whatever I see is perishable; with whom, then, can a firm bond be made?
ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ. ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ; ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
O my mind, know this rightly: love of Maya is false.
ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ. ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ. ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
He alone understands, he alone is a saint, who is kept clear of wandering after Maya.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ. ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
The one You are pleased with, Lord, You pull out of the blind dark well.
ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ; ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
In whose hand lies the power to do this, and who is able to shape every cause,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ; ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, that Lord I praise, who makes this occasion for me. ॥26॥
ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
The bonds that cast him into birth and death break, and by serving the Guru he gains spiritual joy,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the person whose mind never forgets God, the treasure of virtues. ॥1॥
ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ. ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Serve and worship the One alone, from whose door no one goes away empty.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ; ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
If He dwells in your mind, body, mouth and heart, you receive whatever you ask for.
ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
But the chance of this service comes only to one to whom the Guru is kind,
ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ; ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
and a person stays in the Guru's company only if God Himself shows mercy.
ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
We have searched every place and seen: without the Name there is no spiritual peace.
ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ; ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Even the messengers of death step aside from those who lose themselves in the Guru's presence.
Again and again I give myself up to the Guru.
O Nanak, at his door the traces of misdeeds from many births are destroyed. ॥27॥
ਠਾਕ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ, ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Those You are pleased with, Lord, meet no obstacle on the way to Your door.
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, most fortunate are those whom God has made His own. ॥1॥
256: They do not hurt anyone's heart,
those who give up every attachment and stay joined to the One alone.
But those caught up in Maya, who clash again and again with others and bring spiritual death on themselves,
ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
never come to know spiritual joy within.
One who lives in the company of the Guru's people has coolness in his mind,
and the life-giving Name soaks into his very being.
The person who becomes pleasing to the dear Lord,
O Nanak, his mind stays calm for ever. ॥28॥
ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
O Lord of all powers, countless times I bow before You.
ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ. ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, pray: give me Your hand, Lord, and keep me from wavering in attachment to Maya. ॥1॥
ਡਡਾ. ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
This world is not your lasting place; recognise the place that is your real, permanent home.
ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Joined to the Guru's word, come to understand the way of staying in that home for ever.
ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ; ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
A person toils and labours hard for this worldly dwelling,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ; ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
yet not a scrap of it goes with him.
ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ; ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
The ways of that lasting home are understood only by the one
on whom the perfect Lord looks with mercy.
Those who find, in the company of the holy, that lasting and unshakeable home,
O Nanak, their minds do not waver. ॥29॥
ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ. ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ; ਕਿਨਹਿ. ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
The flood of vices does not wear them down, and not a single vice can block their way,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who tie themselves to the company of the holy and are saved by repeating God's Name. ॥1॥
ਢਢਾ. ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ; ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Where else are you wandering in search? The search is to be made in this very mind.
ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ; ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
God lives with you; why do you roam from forest to forest looking for Him?
In the company of the holy, pull down the heap built of your dreadful, proud way of thinking.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Seeing Him, your soul will bloom; you will find spiritual joy and settle in steadiness.
ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ, ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
While the heap of pride stands, a person keeps being born and dying and suffers in the round of births.
ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ; ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Drunk on attachment he clings to Maya, and because of pride he keeps coming and going.
ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ; ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
Those who in this birth come and fall into the refuge of the holy,
ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, have their nooses of suffering cut, and God joins them to Himself. ॥30॥
ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ; ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
(The Judge of Dharma says:) Where the holy worship God and His praise is sung every day,
ਣਾ ਹਉ. ਣਾ ਤੂੰ. ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
do not go near that place, my messengers, or neither I nor you will be spared. ॥1॥
ਣਾਣਾ. ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ; ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
The battle on this field of the world is won only if a person conquers his own self.
ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ. ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who fights pride and duality and dies to pride is the great hero.
ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ. ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
One who by the perfect Guru's teaching ends his pride and can no longer be overcome by worldly craving,
ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ. ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
who masters his own mind, meets God; his alone is the uniform of the brave.
ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ; ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
One who takes the One alone as his prop and support and counts no other as his own,
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
who remembers the all-pervading, limitless Lord day and night,
ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ. ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
who makes this mind of his the dust of everyone's feet, the person who lives in this way,
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
O Nanak, understands God's will and enjoys lasting joy; the record of his past good deeds shows on his forehead. ॥31॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
I would offer body, mind and wealth to whoever brings me to God,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, for then wandering and fear are cut away, and even the glare of death is no more. ॥1॥
ਤਤਾ. ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
Set your love on God the King, the treasure of all virtues;
ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ; ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
you will gain the fruits your mind longs for, and its burning will go.
257: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ. ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ; ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
The dread of death's road is wiped out for one in whose mind the Name comes to dwell.
ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
You will reach the high spiritual state, your understanding will be lit, and your awareness will rest at God's feet.
ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
Give up this chasing: neither wealth nor home, youth nor rule will go with you.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ; ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
Stay in the company of the holy and keep remembering God; this alone will serve you in the end.
ਤਾਤਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
No anguish at all can remain when God Himself is there to remove suffering.
ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ; ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, God Himself looks after us as a mother and father do. ॥32॥
ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
Those in Maya's grip wear themselves out running after it in many ways, yet they are never satisfied and their craving does not end;
ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
piling it up they bring spiritual death on themselves, O Nanak, and Maya does not go with them. ॥1॥
ਥਥਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ; ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
No one stays here for ever; why, fool, do you stretch out your feet?
ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ. ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
For Maya alone you go to endless lengths and practise countless frauds and deceits.
ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ. ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
You gather wealth, fool, you run about for it and collapse exhausted,
ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
but at the last moment it will be of no use to your soul.
ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Take to heart the teaching of the Guru's people and worship God; only then will you find peace within.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ; ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
Give your love always to the One alone; this is the love that lasts.
ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Every cause is in Your hand alone; You alone can act and make others act.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ, ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
Wherever You set them, there they go, O Nanak; these creatures are helpless. ॥33॥
ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
God's servants have seen for certain that the One Himself is the giver of everything,
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, so with the sight of Him as their support they remember Him with every breath. ॥1॥
ਦਦਾ. ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
The One alone is the Giver, able to provide for all beings.
ਦੇਂਦੇ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
His countless storehouses stand full, and giving never runs them short.
The Giver who is always present over you,
foolish mind, why do you forget Him?
Yet, my friend, no one can be blamed for this,
for God Himself has set the barrier of attachment to Maya in the way.
Those whose pangs You Yourself take away, Lord,
O Nanak, take the Guru's refuge and have their fill of Maya. ॥34॥
ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ; ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
O my soul, lean on the One alone and drop all hope in any other.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, keep the Name always in mind, and every task comes right. ॥1॥
ਧਧਾ, ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
The restless wandering stops if one comes to keep the company of the saints.
ਧੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ; ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Only the one on whom You Yourself show mercy from Your court gains a right understanding of life in his mind.
The real bankers are those who hold the wealth that lasts,
who trade in the capital of God's Name.
Composure comes to them, and they earn honour and good repute,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
those who keep listening to God's Name with their ears.
Those in whose hearts the Name dwells through the Guru,
O Nanak, are the ones who receive honour. ॥35॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
O Nanak, those who have lovingly repeated the Name, and only the Name, while going about their work,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
have been shown God close by through the perfect Guru; in the Guru's company dire suffering does not touch them. ॥1॥
They do not fall into the pit of dire suffering,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
those in whose mind and body the Name stays.
Those who through the Guru repeat the Name, knowing it to be the treasure of all things,
ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
do not wear themselves out in Maya, the poison that kills the spirit.
Nothing can bar their way on life's journey,
ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
those to whom the Guru has given the mantra of the Name.
258: Hearts that stay full of the nectar of God's Name, the treasure of all virtues,
O Nanak, hold a joy within like every kind of instrument playing unbroken in one harmony. ॥36॥
ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
The person whose honour the Guru, the Supreme Lord, has protected gives up deceit, attachment and vice.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, always worship that Lord, whose virtues have no end and whose being has no near or far shore. ॥1॥
God's being cannot be measured and His end cannot be found.
He is beyond reach, and He makes pure those who have fallen into vice.
when they meet the Guru and repeat the life-giving Name.
Deceit, fraud and attachment are wiped out from within
the one whom You Yourself protect, O Master of creation.
He is the king of kings; the royal canopy is truly over His head alone.
O Nanak, there is no second who can equal Him. ॥37॥
ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ. ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ; ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
If the mind is conquered, victory is won, the nooses of Maya are cut and the wandering ends.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ; ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, one who receives steadiness of mind from the Guru is finished with the rounds of birth and death for ever. ॥1॥
You have come wandering through countless births,
and now in this world you have this human body, which is so hard to obtain.
ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ; ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
A chance like this will not come to hand again.
If you repeat the Name, the bonds of Maya will be cut away.
ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ; ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
There will be no more coming and going, again and again.
Repeat the name of the One and only Lord.
O Creator Lord, show Your mercy Yourself
and join this helpless one to You, prays Nanak. ॥38॥
ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
O Supreme Lord, kind to the lowly, sustainer of the earth, hear my prayer:
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, let the dust of the feet of the Guru's people be to me all comforts, wealth and the enjoyment of many pleasures. ॥1॥
The real Brahmins are those who come to know God.
The real Vaishnavs are those who take the Guru's refuge and keep the duty of inner purity.
Count him a hero who wipes out of himself the habit of wishing others ill;
the ill that others wish him does not come near him.
A person is himself tied in the bonds of his own pride,
yet in his blindness he lays the blame on others.
Talk and cleverness are of no use here at all.
O Nanak, only the one to whom You give this understanding, Lord, comes to understand. ॥39॥
ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ; ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Keep in your mind the Lord who takes sins away; He breaks all fears and destroys all sin and suffering.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those in whose hearts He comes to rest in the company of the holy do not stray into vice. ॥1॥
Put an end to your habit of straying after this world.
The company of this whole world is like a dream.
Heavenly beings, humans, goddesses and gods have been brought low straying after it.
Adepts, seekers and even the likes of Brahma have strayed after it.
Straying and straying, people have gone on being deceived.
This Maya is a vast and treacherous sea, very hard to cross.
Those who took the Guru's refuge and wiped out straying, fear and attachment from within,
O Nanak, have gained the highest spiritual joy. ॥40॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ; ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
The mind wavers in many ways for the sake of Maya and stays clinging to it.
ਮਾਗਨ. ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the one whom You hold back from asking for Maya alone, Lord, comes to love Your Name. ॥1॥
The ignorant creature is for ever asking,
while the Giver, who knows every heart, goes on giving.
The gifts He gives never run out.
Foolish mind, why do you keep crying out for Maya?
Whenever you ask, you ask for things other than the Name,
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
from which no one has ever had peace within.
If you must ask for something, ask for the Name of the One alone,
O Nanak, by which you may pass beyond all asking for the things of Maya. ॥41॥
259: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
Those in whose minds the perfect Guru's teaching settles gain a complete understanding and become people of standing.
ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who have come to know their dear Lord closely are the fortunate ones. ॥1॥
One who has found out God's secret, that He is always close at hand,
becomes fully convinced of it on joining the company of the holy.
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ; ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Pain and pleasure come to seem alike in his heart,
so he is kept from sinking into the distress of sorrow or the elation of joy.
He sees the Lord beside him, and the same Lord beyond the reach of Maya,
the all-pervading Lord dwelling in each and every heart.
ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
From the relish of that he draws such peace
that Maya, O Nanak, can gain no hold on him. ॥42॥
ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Listen, my friends and companions: without God there is no release from Maya's bonds.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who fall at the Guru's feet have their bonds cut. ॥1॥
A person makes efforts of many kinds,
ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
but without the Name of the One there can be no success at all.
The effort by which release does come
is this: keep the company of the holy.
Everyone sets his mind on some way of escape,
ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
yet without repeating His Name there is no escape.
You Yourself, Lord, are the ship to carry beings across, and You alone have the power to do it.
O Master of beings, save us who are without virtue.
ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
Those in whose thought, word and deed God Himself wakes this understanding,
O Nanak, find their minds made bright. ॥43॥
ਰੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Do not be angry with anyone else; look into your own self instead.
ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ. ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, if you live in the world with a gentle nature, by God's glance of mercy you will get across. ॥1॥
ਰਾਰਾ; ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
The Guru, of whose feet the whole world is the dust,
before him give up your pride, so that your outstanding account is cleared.
You will succeed on the field of this world and in God's presence, brother, only
ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
when you take the Guru's refuge and fix your awareness on God's Name.
Little by little, countless vices fall away
when one is joined to the word of the perfect Guru.
They stay dyed in love of the Name and absorbed in its taste,
O Nanak, those to whom the Guru has given the gift of God's Name. ॥44॥
ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
Greed, falsehood, vice and disease hold sway in this body.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
But O Nanak, one who takes the Guru's refuge and drinks the life-giving nectar of God's Name stays settled in spiritual joy. ॥1॥
I am certain that whoever is given this medicine
has his pain and suffering wiped out in a moment.
The person whose heart grows fond of the medicine of the Name
is not approached by any disease, even in a dream.
ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
The medicine of God's Name is there in every heart, brother,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
but without the perfect Guru the way of using it does not work.
The perfect Guru has laid down the regimen that goes with it;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ; ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
O Nanak, one who keeps to it is not touched by suffering again. ॥45॥
ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ; ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
God is present everywhere; there is no place where He is lacking.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He is with all, inside and all around; nothing can be hidden from Him. ॥1॥
for God is contained in every body.
God pervades the water and the land,
but only a rare one, by the Guru's grace, has reached Him.
ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ; ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
Enmity and opposition are wiped from the minds of those
who take the Guru's refuge and listen to God's praise.
God is apart from all caste and class, form and feature.
260: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
O Nanak, those who take the Guru's refuge and remember the Lord reach this state. ॥46॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
Foolish, ignorant people in Maya's grip pass their lives in the one thought, "let me be great, me alone".
ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ. ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, because of deeds done in pride, its thorn keeps pricking them to spiritual death, as a thirsty man dies for want of water. ॥1॥
The prick of pride's thorn is removed only in the Guru's company,
for remembering the Name is the essence of all religious deeds.
One in whose heart the beautiful Lord comes to dwell,
in him the prick of that thorn is surely destroyed and wiped out.
That rankling of pride is kept alive by those fools in Maya's grip,
in whose hearts lodge the evils born of a proud intellect.
Those who take the Guru's refuge and remove the prick of pride,
O Nanak, the Guru shows them a glimpse of spiritual bliss in the blink of an eye. ॥47॥
ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ; ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
O mind, take the Guru's support; give up your arguments and cleverness.
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, one in whose mind the Guru's teaching dwells has good fortune written on his forehead. ॥1॥
Defeated, we have now come to Your refuge, O Master of the earth.
The pandits read aloud the Shastras, Simritis and Vedas,
but after much reflection one arrives at this conclusion:
without remembering the Lord's Name there is no release.
With every breath we go on making mistakes.
You are able to forgive them; Your virtues are beyond count and without end.
O merciful One, protect the honour of those who come to Your refuge.
O Nanak, pray: O Sustainer of the world, we are Your children. ॥48॥
ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ. ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
When a person's pride is removed, he finds spiritual bliss, and his mind and body become healthy.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, he then sees everywhere the God who truly deserves praise. ॥1॥
With my whole mind I praise that Lord,
ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਊਨੇ. ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
who in an instant fills to the brim the hearts that were empty of virtue.
When a person becomes thoroughly free of pride,
he remembers at all times the God who is free of desire.
ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ; ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
He becomes dear to the Master, and God grants him spiritual peace.
The Supreme God is so boundless,
He forgives countless sins in an instant.
O Nanak, the Master is always merciful. ॥49॥
ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ. ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
O my mind, listen, I tell you the truth: take the refuge of God the King.
ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, give up all arguments and cleverness, and God will join you to His feet. ॥1॥
O my ignorant mind, give up your cleverness.
God is not pleased by cleverness or by giving orders.
Even if you practise a thousand kinds of cleverness,
not one of them will go with you to help you.
Remember Him, Him alone, day and night, O my soul;
it is His remembrance that will go with you.
One whom God Himself joins to the Guru's service,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
O Nanak, no suffering can press upon him. ॥50॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ; ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
When the Lord, repeated with the mouth, comes to dwell in the mind, spiritual bliss arises.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, that God pervades all beings and is present within every place. ॥1॥
ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
I see that God Himself is present in the body of every being.
ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ. ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
God has existed for ever and destroys suffering: the Guru's wisdom gives this understanding.
ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ. ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ; ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
When pride ends, joy arises in the mind; where there is no pride, God Himself dwells.
ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Through the blessing of the saints' company, the sufferings of birth and death are destroyed.
One who with love fixes the Name of the merciful Lord in his heart
and stays in the company of the saints, to him God is kind.
